issues.on_page: Licenses, permits and fees: Papillion Landing 2,493,982 + Papio Bay 324,967
issues.issue: The item's own review note says these columns are treated as charges for services, but the category is still licenses and permits. The budget schedules (p11-12) print them as 'Charges for services', and the user rule puts recreation/pool/park fees under Recreation Fees. The split by fund column (printed on p4) and the arithmetic are correct.

The line is labelled grants, and the Statement of Activities (p2) shows it under operating grants and contributions. Its source is not stated, so this could be a government grant rather than a private donation.

issues.on_page: Charges for services 22,686,645 (Water 10,588,486, Sewer 9,368,718, Golf 2,729,441); Merchandise sales / Concession sales (Golf); Lease income 64,565
issues.issue: The user's 2026-10-28 categories (Utility Charges, Recreation Fees, Rentals) fit these business-type receipts better than generic charges for services. The same applies to the detail Papillion Landing/Papio Bay 'Charges for services' lines (category charges for services/fees, detail recreation/pool/park fees).

issues.on_page: Cost of merchandise sold 257,571 / Cost of concessions sold 369,763
issues.issue: Under the utility cost-type rule these lines would be Purchased Power/Cost of Sales. The other enterprise lines use cost types; these two use a function. Golf-column handling is already in decision_needed.

issues.on_page: Accrued compensated absences (due within one year 1,868,714 / 426,490; due in more than one year 2,535,147 / 507,236)
issues.issue: Compensated absences get two different categories: Accrued Liabilities for the current part and other liabilities for the long-term part. The user's balance-sheet rule names Compensated Absences as its own category for due-within / due-in-more-than-one-year lines.
Keno tax paid to the state is placed under general government in a fund whose purpose is community betterment (economic development). This is a judgment call and is already marked for review.
